lines.speaker: Capt. Rennick

lines.speaker: Shade

lines.text: A Unity pilot greets Hoard. How polite the dead can be.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: You have reached the one who prices your ship.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: You return. Good. Debts like company.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Help has a price. Everything has.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Nothing hunts you this minute. That, too, I can sell.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Quiet is a favour. Favours are owed.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Bring me a hauler's manifest and you may keep your hull.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: My work is for corsairs. Are you one?

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: I sell one thing to outsiders: passage. It is not cheap.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Cargo, ships, pilots. All have a price in Vega.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Vega is mine. Ask where you may fly, not where things are.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Beyond Vega I do not care.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: I am Hoard. Vega pays me so it may keep breathing.

lines.speaker: Hoard

lines.text: The ice field is full and patient.

lines.speaker: Hoard

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Some secrets should never die. Neither should grudges.

lines.speaker: Hoard

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Better. Now bring credits with the words.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: The price on your ship just went up.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Insults are free. Passage is not. You will want passage.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Enough. Vega will be your grave.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: I am finished pricing you. Now I am only hunting.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Threats, in my space. My crews heard that.

lines.speaker: Hoard
lines.text: Mercy is for sale. Say the word tribute and bring credits.

lines.speaker: Hoard

lines.text: Ask plainly or pay for my patience.
